How your Stocklist score works 7 factors · 100 points

Technical signals use completed daily candles: SMA 50/200, Wilder RSI 14, MACD 12/26/9, OBV over 5 sessions, Bollinger 20/2, and stochastic 14/3. Crossovers look back 5 sessions. Rankings use the technical score out of 90 while market context is incomplete; the complete 100-point score is shown only when all four market factors have dated sources.

“Materially stronger” means an eligible stock’s technical score has increased by at least 10 points since its previous distinct snapshot, with at least one improved signal. This threshold is an implementation default. First scans do not claim an improvement. Stale stock rows are excluded.

Data connection Not connected

The source code includes a daily Angel One SmartAPI collector and a weekday refresh workflow. No credentials are stored in this page.

  1. The repository includes an NSE Indices constituent snapshot. Cross-check it against your preferred Moneycontrol Nifty 500 universe before running the scan.
  2. Add your Angel One SmartAPI API key and session JWT to GitHub Actions secrets as ANGEL_API_KEY and ANGEL_ACCESS_TOKEN. Keep it out of repository files and chat.
  3. Run Refresh Stocklist in GitHub Actions. The page reads the saved snapshot automatically. Renew expiring tokens as required by Angel One SmartAPI.

News, macro, sentiment and institutional-flow checks require dated, sourced entries in market-context.json. They remain unverified until supplied. Market-wide FII/DII totals do not establish buying in an individual stock.
